description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for managing WebRTC server connections, including configuration, observer callbacks, and connection handling classes.

classes.name: ServerConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for connecting to the signaling server, including address, port, path, and security level.

classes.name: ServerConnectionObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing WebRTC server connection events such as open, close, error, and message reception.

classes.name: ServerConnection
classes.description: Abstract class representing a connection to the signaling server, with methods for connecting, sending data, and reconnecting.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Static method to create and establish a new server connection with given configuration and observer.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Method to send JSON-encoded data to the server.

methods.name: Reconnect
methods.description: Method to request reconnection to the server.
